rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that consistently supports someone, an institution, or a cause.

example.english: That dog is very loyal to its owner.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 deoi3 zyu2 jan4 hou2 zung1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for especially intense, wholehearted devotion, often toward a person, relationship, or cause.

example.english: He is completely loyal to his girlfriend.
example.traditional: 佢對個女朋友死心塌地。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 go3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 sei2 sam1 taap3 dei6

rows.note: Choose this more formal term especially for loyalty to an institution, authority, or cause.

example.english: He has remained loyal to the company.
example.traditional: 佢對公司一直保持忠誠。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 jat1 zik6 bou2 ci4 zung1 sing4
